newsitem.title: CHINA: SHOUGANG GRAND, SHOUGANG TECH SUSPENDED.
newsitem.headline: SHOUGANG GRAND, SHOUGANG TECH SUSPENDED.

text.p: Trading in shares of Shougang Concord Grand (Group) Ltd and Shougang Concord Technology Holdings Ltd was suspended at the companies' request pending an announcement, the stock exchange said on Thursday.

The stocks were suspended at 10.27 a.m. (0227 gmt) following a suspension of trading in shares of their parent Shougang Concord International Enterprises Co Ltd and its other unit Shougang Concord Century Holdings Ltd.
Shares of Shougang Grand surged HK$0.40 to HK$3.30 on early Thursday before trading was suspended. They rose HK$0.475 to HK$2.90 on Wednesday.
Shougang Technology shares surged HK$0.30 to HK$1.81 on Thursday morning after they closed at HK$1.51, up HK$0.27, on Wednesday.
Shougang Grand is involved in property development, finance and strategic investments while Shougang Technology is a maker of telephones, power cords and plugs.

They said earlier in separate announcements that they were not aware of any reasons for the recent increases in prices and volumes of their shares. They also confirmed that there were no negotiations or agreements discloseable under listing rules.
